people.imagined: She falls asleep with shavings in her hair and wakes with them in her bed; today she is bent over a fallen pine, feeling the grain.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a fallen pine in the blue hush of evening, she runs one palm along the grain and looks up with a stubborn frown. Face (most important: pale wood shavings curled all through her black hair): a narrow, determined, freckled face with a straight nose, strong straight brows drawn low, alert hazel eyes, a firm mouth, a tiny scar on the left cheek and a shaving stuck to the cheek. Hair: thick black hair in a loose tail held with a plain green cord, many pale curled shavings tangled in it. Body: lean with strong forearms, crouched low. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple, two crossed collars of pale bark-cream gauze over a pine-green under-robe, wide sleeves tied back with silk cord above the wrist, a narrow cream sash with a small roll of silk-wrapped carving gravers hung from it, hems embroidered with tiny pine needles in darker green; no jewellery but a plain jade bead. Hands and objects: one palm flat along the split fallen pine, the other holding a small mallet; a half-carved wooden bird sits on the log. Power: a few faint green motes of wood qi drift up from the grain under her palm, barely visible. Background: dark pines in drifting mist, the far roof of a hall glimmering with spirit-lamps. Light: soft silver moonlight from the upper left with a green rim light along her hair, picking out every curl of shaving. Expression: a stubborn, honest frown of concentration, lower lip pushed forward, diligent to the point of forgetting anyone is watching.

people.imagined: Asleep on watch among the grain sacks, a crust in his pocket; he wakes to find a mouse on his knee and names it.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a grain sack in a dim granary, half-awake with one eye open, he finds a small grey mouse on his knee and has just named it, a crust in his hand. Face: a round, sleepy, content face with plump cheeks, heavy drooping lids, a short nose, pale grain dust whitening his eyebrows so he looks old, and a slack smile. Hair: brown and rumpled, dusted white with grain. Body: soft, round-shouldered and sprawled comfortably. Clothing: a low-realm outer disciple's graceful but rumpled silk: a pale bark-cream robe with two loosely crossed collars, wide sleeves hanging slack, pine-green borders embroidered with needles and gone dusty at the hem, a loose pine-green sash worn untied; across his chest a plain green silk guard-cord of the granary watch, and a bulging sleeve-pocket trailing crumbs. Hands and objects: a stale crust in the right hand, the left lifting two fingers toward the mouse; a short staff of pale pine wood tipped with a jade bead leans beside him. Power: none, only a very faint green shimmer in the air above the sacks. Background: grain sacks rising to a high rafter, slits of gold spirit-light and drifting motes across the floor, a small mouse-hole in the stone. Light: warm moon-gold light from the upper left through the slits, a soft glow on the mouse on his knee. Expression: a lazy, very comfortable half-smile, the one open eye soft and amused, a content man who sees no reason to stand while there is bread.

people.imagined: On horseback, the whip uncoiled across his saddle, he looks over the village with a flat cold eye; the wolf tooth gleams at his throat.
people.subject: The moment: mounted on a brown horse at the edge of a misty road at dusk, he looks down at the viewer from the saddle, one hand resting on a long whip coiled across the saddle front. Face (most important: a wolf-tooth charm on a cord at the throat, and a cold flat stare): a hard handsome young face with a sharp jaw, a straight cruel mouth, narrow pale eyes under thin brows, a scar across the upper lip, a hooked nose, hollow cheeks and pale lashes so the eyes seem almost white; the wolf's tooth thick, yellow and curved, at his collar. Hair: black, cut short and bound in a small silver-pinned knot with a pine twig tucked above the ear. Body: tall, long-limbed and upright in the saddle. Clothing: an outer disciple's riding robe of pale bark-cream silk with crossed collars of pine-green, wide sleeves caught at the wrist by black silk cords, hems embroidered with needles and wind-curls in dark green, a needle-green sash, a horse's brown flank at the edge. Hands and objects: a long whip of black braided silk cord and the right hand on its handle; a small wolf-head stud of dull silver on the saddle. Power: a faint cold-green wisp coils about the whip handle. Background: a village of low houses with smoky roofs below in blue mist, a track vanishing into low hills. Light: pale cold moonlight from the upper left with a thin green rim, making the wolf tooth shine like bone and putting a hard shadow under his brows. Expression: a flat, cold stare, the mouth still, no flicker of feeling.

people.imagined: Angry, she touches the plum-blossom scar on her forearm, the one the refused sword did not give her; she wants to prove them wrong.
people.subject: The moment: angry, she grips her own forearm with her thumb on a scar and glares at the viewer with stubborn defiance, wanting to prove them wrong. Face: a young strong face with a firm square chin, straight dark brows pulled low, bright proud dark eyes that burn, a tight mouth, flushed cheeks and a small cut healing on the lip. Hair: black, in a tight high tail bound with a green silk cord and a jade pine twig. Body: lean, hard-muscled and rigid. Clothing: an outer disciple's graceful silk, a pine-green robe under a pale bark-cream gauze over-layer, crossed collars, the right sleeve pushed up and the left bound at the wrist with a strip of green silk, borders embroidered with pine needles, a needle-green sash tied hard. Hands and objects (the scar is the lead): the left hand holds the bared right forearm, where a pale scar shaped like a five-petalled plum blossom stands out plainly, as big as a coin; a sliver of dark iron just visible at the sleeve cuff. Power: a thin green-white shimmer of unspent qi along her clenched hand. Background: a pale gravel yard of the sect, a row of dark pines in mist, a wooden practice post to one side. Light: cold moon-silver light from the upper left giving a sharp highlight on the scar and the clenched hand, a soft green rim along her cheek. Expression: angry pride, the jaw clenched and the dark eyes level, brave, stubborn and quietly dangerous, a young woman refusing to let a refused sword define her.

people.imagined: Walking the ten weeks back to the village of the dead pines, a damp-wrapped sapling in his pack, patient and calm.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on a misty path at dawn, he carefully lifts a small damp-cloth-wrapped sapling from his pack, looking up at the viewer with gentle eyes. Face (most important: a pine sapling with a wet cloth wrapped round its roots, held in both hands in front of his chest): a mild, thin, kind face with soft brown eyes, level eyebrows, a long straight nose, a quiet gentle smile, sun-browned skin, small ears, lips a little chapped by the road, a faint tan line across the brow. Hair: dark brown, in a neat topknot with a green cord and a jade pine twig. Body: lean and gently stooped, walking-worn. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a young inner disciple, a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves rolled twice at the wrist, hems embroidered with needles and dusty from the road, a needle-green silk sash hung with a small jade pine-cone pendant; a bundle pack on his back with wide cloth straps, a travel staff against the shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands holding a pine sapling about a forearm tall, its roots wrapped in dripping cloth. Power: a soft green glow of wood qi gathers round the sapling and faint motes rise from it. Background: a path between young pines of equal height, each with a small wooden tag tied to a lower branch, mist between the trunks. Light: soft green-gold dawn light from the upper left with a gentle rim, a damp shine on the cloth. Expression: gentle, lowered eyes lifting to the viewer, a soft patient smile and a tender look toward the sapling.

people.imagined: He stands as if a roll were being read over him, the clan-seal ring turned inward; he is ready to report each doubt.
people.subject: The moment: standing stiffly at attention in a pale hall as if a roll were being read over him, chin up, he looks at the viewer with cold composure, ready to report each doubt. Face (most important: a heavy silver clan-seal ring turned inward so only the plain band shows, on a rigid raised hand): a handsome, severe young face with a high nose, thin proud lips, level cold eyes, finely drawn brows, a faint sneer and a line of tension at the corner of the mouth. Hair: black, combed back and pinned in a tidy topknot with a white-jade pin. Body: tall, straight and rigid, shoulders back. Clothing: a refined inner disciple's silk, a crisp pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, the outermost stiff and perfectly flat, edged with silver thread in a plain wave, a pine-green over-robe with narrow tailored wide sleeves embroidered with dark pine needles, a needle-green silk sash with a jade clasp carved as a pine bough and a pine-cone pendant of green jade. Hands and objects: the left hand held up at chest height, palm inward, the thick silver ring turned so its band shows; long pale fingers with a small ink stain on the right forefinger, the right hand resting on the sash. Power: a very faint cool green aura, thin and tidy as a ruled line. Background: pale pillars and a polished floor with a faint reflection of his boots, a plain paper screen glowing behind. Light: cold even moonlight from the upper left, a thin green rim, no soft shadows, the face looking carved. Expression: formal and calm, lips thin, eyes cool, ambitious and arrogant, a man already composing his report.

people.imagined: By the hot spring, towels over both shoulders and steam rising off her, she hears everything the old soakers say.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a hot spring with a pile of towels on both shoulders and a thin plume of steam around her, she smiles at the viewer with an eye on a bargain. Face: a round, rosy, shiny face from the steam, bright dark eyes beaded with tiny drops on the lashes, a snub nose, a wide cheerful mouth, a damp curl stuck to the temple. Hair: black, in two buns held with small blue-green ribbons, damp and curling. Body: plump and warm, sleeves rolled. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful silk, a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled back, the cuffs and collar damp, pine-green borders embroidered with pine needles, a soft green sash, a small embroidered silk coin purse on a cord crossed over her chest, tiny wooden clogs on her feet. Hands and objects (the towels are the lead): white towels draped over both shoulders and one arm, a stack of folded towels held against her chest. Power: a faint blue-green mist of water qi mixes with the steam round her hands. Background: a hot spring pool beneath white vapour, ringed with flat grey stones, a lacquer rack of little clay cups, lanterns glowing through the mist. Light: warm lantern glow and soft moonlight from the upper left lighting the steam into a gentle halo. Expression: a bright, cheerful smile with sharp bargain-seeking eyes and flushed, steam-damp cheeks.

people.imagined: In a heavy coat with antler buttons that he wears in the lowlands too; he tells people he has no friends and smiles calmly.
people.subject: The moment: standing quietly in a heavy coat that he wears even in the lowlands, he looks at the viewer sideways with a still, unreadable expression, a man who tells people he has no friends and smiles calmly. Face (most important: a thick fur-trimmed coat with ten big carved antler buttons in two rows down the front): a calm, wide, weathered face with high flat cheekbones, narrow dark eyes with a faint fold at the corners, a broad nose, a straight mouth with the faintest smile, wind-chapped cheeks and a few white hairs in the eyebrows. Hair: black and long, in a single braid tied with a silver-white ribbon. Body: stocky and thick-chested. Clothing: a northern herder's coat of soft grey reindeer fur and quilted pale silk with a deep fur collar and ten pale carved antler buttons, closed by a wide plaited silk belt, worn over a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars whose borders are embroidered with pine needles and a needle-green cord at the throat. Hands and objects: a fur-lined glove in one hand; the other rests on the button row. Power: a thin frost-blue shimmer of water qi lies on the fur like hoar. Background: a pale green lowland field with a small herd of reindeer grazing, one blurred at the edge, a thin line of smoke from a distant tent, soft mist. Light: soft silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, settling on the fur like frost. Expression: a closed, quiet face, the mouth almost smiling and the eyes giving nothing away, calm and withdrawn, courteous in a way that keeps people at a distance.

people.imagined: He clicks the pocket abacus on its cord as he walks and calculates a tenth of the good lots; he is smiling at a customer.
people.subject: The moment: he holds up a tiny abacus on a cord and clicks a bead with his thumb, smiling at the viewer with calm greed. Face: a smooth, handsome merchant's-son face with bright quick brown eyes, an easy broad smile, a neat thin moustache, sleek eyebrows, a cheerful sweetness that is practised; slim clean fingers with neat nails, a small gold ring on the left little finger. Hair: black, oiled, in a high knot bound with a green cord and a small gold pin. Body: slender, polished, upright. Clothing: a well-tailored inner disciple's silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with a clean white inner collar and two crossed outer collars, a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves whose cuffs are embroidered with fine gold-thread pine needles and tiny coins, a needle-green sash with a brass buckle and a jade pine-cone pendant, a small embroidered brocade satchel on a strap. Hands and objects: a pocket abacus the size of a palm on a cord held up in the right hand, one bead pushed over; the left holds a small lump of amber resin glowing from within. Power: a faint warm green-gold shimmer where the amber glows, nothing more. Background: a resin warehouse, rows of sealed barrels with amber lumps on top, blurred clerks bent over a bench in a high gold-lit hall. Light: warm amber spirit-light from the upper left shining on the resin and picking out a gleam on the abacus beads. Expression: a smooth, pleasant smile with warm, calm eyes that are quietly counting.

people.imagined: He cannot stand still through a speech; a coin-sized hole in his sleeve where a smoking coin burned through; he is selling the rest of the old coins.
people.subject: The moment: fidgeting, half turned, he holds up a dull old coin between finger and thumb to the viewer with a quick bright grin, selling off the rest of the old coins, unable to stand still. Face: a thin, quick, impish boy's face with large bright eyes that dart sideways as if looking for the next buyer, a pointed nose with a smear of dust, ruddy cheeks, ears that stick out and a wide grin with a front tooth missing. Hair: black, wild and sticking out in several directions, a green ribbon half fallen out. Body: thin, wiry and restless, caught mid-step. Clothing: a new outer disciple's graceful silk, a little too big for him: a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars and sleeves that fall past his hands, pine-green borders embroidered with needles, a small singed hole with brown edges burned through the right sleeve and a bit of elbow showing (a smoking coin did it, and he is proud of the hole), a loose green sash, a silk bag on a strap and a string of old coins at the belt. Hands and objects: a flat round old silver coin with a square hole held up beside his face; the other hand in the open bag. Power: a faint orange spark of old coin-fire still curls off the burnt hole. Background: a pale temple yard with a crowd of pilgrims with bundles and staffs blurred behind him and a market stall under a pine in drifting mist. Light: bright silver-gold spirit-light from the upper left making the coin flash and putting a glint in his eye. Expression: a salesman's grin, quick, gap-toothed and a little shifty, the eyes bright with cheerful deceit and an appetite for company.

people.imagined: Between sentences she chews the end of her braid; she has just told a lie that she half hopes no one believes.
people.subject: The moment: in a hushed hall she chews the tip of a braid held in her fingers and looks at the viewer with wide innocent eyes, between sentences, having just told a lie she half hopes no one believes. Face (most important: the end of the braid between her teeth): a young, pale, serious face with wide dark eyes, thin level brows, a small chin, small bitten lips, a faint crease of thought and a blotch of ink on the chin. Hair: long black hair in a single thick braid over the left shoulder, tied with a green silk cord, the chewed end damp. Body: slender and a little hunched. Clothing: a young inner disciple's graceful silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe whose wide sleeves are a little too long and fall over her fingers, borders embroidered with pine needles and tiny sound-waves in darker green, a needle-green sash tied in a bow with uneven ends, a small silk pouch for zither strings and a little jade pine-cone pendant at the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts the braid to her mouth; the left holds a bundle of thin silk strings loosely. Power: a very faint pale-green ripple in the air near her lips, like a note not yet sounded. Background: tall pale wooden pillars rising into shadow, a few cushions on the floor, a silent zither case in the corner, drifting mist. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left falling on the damp braid end and her wide eyes, a gentle green rim along her cheek. Expression: a wide-eyed, calm innocence with the lips pressed around the braid, an earnest look that hides a small fib and invites you to believe it.

people.imagined: A measuring rope wound round her waist like a belt, she is quietly placing array stones better than the man she carries them for.
people.subject: The moment: crouching in a hall of faintly glowing chalk lines, she sets an array stone carefully in a chalk circle with both hands and glances up at the viewer, serious and exact, quietly placing array stones better than the man she carries them for. Face (most important: a coil of measuring cord wound round her waist like a belt, knots tied at regular marks): a lean, serious, plain face with a straight nose, careful dark brows with a faint crease between them, grey-brown eyes, a firm mouth and a smear of chalk on one cheek. Hair: black, in a tight braid pinned up with a jade pine twig. Body: sturdy and strong, in a crouch, chalk-dusted hands. Clothing: a young inner disciple's graceful silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe and a pine-green over-robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back with silk bands, chalk-white on the knees, borders embroidered in dark green with tiny circles and spoke-lines like arrays, a knotted measuring cord of green silk round her waist as a sash with a knot every hand's width, the ends tipped with black lacquer. Hands and objects: both hands set a flat grey stone the size of a loaf in a chalk ring; a small jade plumb-bob hangs at her side. Power: faint amber-gold lines of earth qi glow along the chalk where the stone touches it. Background: a bare floor drawn with white chalk circles and spoke lines, a slender wooden frame with a plumb line in the corner, pale mist. Light: pale moon-silver light from the upper left and the soft amber glow of the lines under her hands, showing the chalk with crisp clarity. Expression: a cautious, patient concentration, the mouth firm and the eyes on the stone, content to be exact and let others take the credit.

people.imagined: The stove boy has just dropped another bowl; he grins sheepishly, soot on his nose, shards at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a palace kitchen with a cracked ceramic bowl dropped half-way, he grins sheepishly at the viewer. Face (most important: a broad sheepish grin with soot on the nose and a ruddy fire-lit face): a round, ruddy, friendly face with a smudge of black soot across the nose and cheek, large honest brown eyes, a big awkward grin, thick brows, sweat at the temples, large red ears, long lashes, flour settled in his eyebrows. Hair: black, a mess, tied back with a faded red cloth. Body: big and gangly, long arms, careless. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain but clean pale cotton, the sleeves rolled, a green cloth sash knotted twice at the waist, the cloth on his head a faded red rag, a splash of soup on one sleeve; no silk, no jewels, the plainest dress in the house but neat. Hands and objects: a broken bowl in two halves held in both hands, a wooden ladle under the arm. Power: none; only a few warm orange sparks from the stove drifting up behind him. Background: a kitchen with a red-lit stove, a big iron pot, steaming kettle, hanging pans and bundles of dried peppers on the wall, rising steam. Light: orange stove glow from the lower right and soft cool moonlight through a window at the upper left, the glow lighting his round cheek and the shards in his hands. Expression: a sheepish grin with sooty cheeks, eyebrows lifted in embarrassment and a flush rising.

people.imagined: In midsummer she wears gloves; the cup in her hand has frosted. She is a pledge, watchful and apart.
people.subject: The moment: holding a small tea cup in both gloved hands, she looks at the viewer with quiet reserve, a delicate frost on the cup. Face (most important: thin white gloves in midsummer, and a cup furred with white frost): a pale, fine-featured face with a high forehead, pale grey-blue eyes, thin pale brows, a small closed mouth, skin almost translucent with a faint blue tint at the temples, pale pink lips and a tiny snowflake of frost resting on her lower lashes. Hair: black, in a smooth long braid over one shoulder with a silver snowflake pin and a jade pine twig. Body: slight, upright, cool. Clothing: an outer disciple's fine silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, the inner collar lined with a thin strip of white fur, a pale pine-green over-robe of gauze with long sleeves covering to the wrists, borders embroidered with silver pine needles and frost-flowers, a needle-green sash with a small jade pendant, thin white silk gloves reaching past the wrist under the sleeve. Hands and objects: a pale grey stone tea cup held in gloved hands, a thick fur of white frost on its outside and a little cold mist rising. Power: a soft frost-blue aura of water qi hangs about her, tiny ice crystals glittering in the air. Background: a sunlit summer window with green leaves, softly blurred, and a low plain table with a second untouched cup beside her. Light: warm summer light from the upper left that makes the frost on the cup glitter and her skin look even paler, with a cool blue rim on her cheek. Expression: a quiet, reserved face with lowered lashes and a closed, composed mouth, pale and watchful.

people.imagined: At the listening terrace at dusk she holds the taper over the dusk stick. An envoy has stopped mid-sentence under her stare.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still at dusk with a long taper held up toward a pine-cone censer, she fixes the viewer with a steady unblinking stare. Face (most important: a stare, steady and wide-eyed, unblinking): a lean, severe, handsome face of about forty with a high straight nose, wide level dark eyes with a stillness that is a little frightening, thin black brows, a thin pale mouth, a firm chin, high cheekbones, ageless smooth skin and a faint shadow in the hollow of the cheek. Hair: black with a single silver strand, drawn back in a tight bun fixed with a long pale pine-wood and jade hairpin. Body: tall, straight, quiet. Clothing: the robes of a steward of the sect: a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, a long pine-green robe with wide still sleeves hanging straight to her fingertips and over it a sheer grey-green gauze over-robe that drifts like smoke, embroidered at the collar, cuffs and hem with pine needles and wind-curls in darker green and silver thread, a needle-green silk sash with a jade pine-cone pendant and a small silver bell. Hands and objects: a long thin taper in her right hand, flame at the tip, held toward a bronze censer shaped like a pine cone on a stone stand, the incense stick unlit. Power: a calm green-gold aura of wood qi lies close about her like a second robe, with a few slow motes rising from the censer. Background: a terrace of pale wood at dusk framed by two tall pines, a faint mist. Light: gold dusk light from the upper left and the taper's steady flame, putting a tiny gold light in each eye, with a soft green rim light. Expression: a still, unblinking stare with a level mouth, no smile, the face utterly motionless.

people.imagined: He sits with his back to the wall facing the door, a flattened chin from a mule-kick; he keeps the wine corked for a friend.
people.subject: The moment: seated square on a bench in a guardroom, facing the viewer as if the viewer were the door, a hand near his belt. Face (most important: a flat, squashed chin, as if it had been pressed in): a heavy, wide face of about forty with a thick short neck, a chin flattened and pushed back into the jaw, small deep-set angry brown eyes under a heavy brow ridge, a broken eyebrow, a scar across the bridge of the nose, a wide tight mouth with a down turn, a grey streak in the stubble. Hair: dark grey, short, with a jade pine twig through a stubby knot. Body: wide-shouldered, solid, sitting upright, alert. Clothing: a patrolman's robe of an inner disciple, pale bark-cream silk with crossed collars under a pine-green over-robe split for riding, wide sleeves bound at the wrist with black silk guards, dark pine-needle embroidery at the hem, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, the cord at his sword hilt wrapped with green thread, dark boots resting square on the floor. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a short sword hilt at the hip; on the table beside him a small corked clay wine jug pushed aside. Power: a heavy green-grey aura of settled wood and metal qi pools about his shoulders, stronger than a young disciple's. Background: a dim guardroom with a plank wall, a rack of spears, a single hanging lantern and the edge of a door showing a strip of night. Light: lantern and spirit-light from the upper left, yellow, throwing the shadow of his chin on his chest, with a cold green rim along the jaw. Expression: a watchful, grim face with lowered brows, a tight jaw and eyes fixed on the door, anger held in.

people.imagined: Walking the flood marks at night, mud on the hem, thinking of the brother whose name the palace will not sing.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a dike she holds a lantern low to read a flood mark on a post, and glances up at the viewer, calm and fierce. Face: a strong, level, grave face of about thirty-four with high cheekbones, dark steady eyes wet in the lamplight under firm brows, a straight mouth, a long jaw and a small crease at the brow. Hair: black, in a thick braid pinned round the head with a silver pin and a jade pine twig. Body: tall, strong, upright. Clothing (the mud is the lead): a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves tied back with grey-green cord, a thick band of drying dike mud up the hem to the knee and dark mud on her boots, embroidered borders of pine needles and waves in green and silver, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant and a small flask. Hands and objects: a paper lantern held low in the left hand, lighting a post painted with ringed marks; the right hand rests on the post. Power: a thin pale-blue glimmer of water qi runs along her fingers where they touch the post, and a few green motes rise from her hair. Background: a night dike with a line of numbered posts running into the dark, a river like black glass with a few distant lights, drifting mist. Light: warm lantern glow from below left, cool silver moonlight from the upper left on her shoulder and the rim of her cheek. Expression: a calm, fierce face lit from below by the lantern, jaw set, eyes steady and hard.

people.imagined: At dawn on the ice edge, bone whistle at his lips, he blows for the lake children and counts them. He passed the test by one point.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pale ice shelf at dawn with a bone whistle between his lips, eyes on the viewer. Face (most important: a pale bone whistle held in the mouth, cheeks puffed): a lean, weathered, earnest face with a long chin, windburnt cheeks, bright quick dark eyes, thick eyebrows raised slightly, a thin black moustache frosted at the tips, a red nose from the cold and a small scar on the temple. Hair: black, in a topknot with a green cord, frost on it. Body: wiry, long-legged, upright. Clothing: an inner disciple's winter silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars and a quilted pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves, a thick grey silk-wadded coat over it closed to the throat with bone toggles, borders embroidered with pine needles and snowflakes, a needle-green sash with a jade pendant, fur-lined mittens tucked in the belt, a short ice-chisel of pale jade strapped to his back. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long white bone whistle to his lips; the left holds a coil of rope. Power: a thin frost-blue shimmer of water qi on the ice around his boots, a faint green mote or two at his shoulder. Background: a frozen lake with lines of small children in padded coats waiting in rows on the ice, little stools and holes cut for fishing, blurred in pale dawn mist. Light: cold rose-and-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left turning the ice rose and gold and glinting on the whistle. Expression: a firm, keen face with cheeks slightly puffed round the whistle and eager eyes fixed ahead.

people.imagined: He plucks a bit of lint from his own sleeve before he looks at anyone's work, a frown of superiority on his face.
people.subject: The moment: in a hall of wet stone he picks a thread of lint from his immaculate sleeve with two fingers and looks at the viewer down his nose. Face (most important: a pinched, fastidious face and a thin sneering mouth): a long, thin, pale, fine-boned face of about forty, a pinched sharp nose, narrow cold eyes, thin brows raised, a slight curl of the lip, a neat thin moustache, cheeks shaved so closely they seem polished, long pale fingers with perfectly clean nails. Hair: black, severely combed and bound in a tight high knot with a green silk cord and a white-jade pin. Body: tall, straight and slim, immaculate. Clothing: a precise inner disciple's silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars and white cuffs without a mark folded exactly twice, a pine-green over-robe pressed perfectly with wide sleeves embroidered in silver thread with tiny array-circles and pine needles, a needle-green sash tied in a perfect flat square knot with a jade clasp, a small silver measuring-cord at his hip. Hands and objects: the right fingers pinch a tiny thread from the left sleeve; a measuring rod of dark wood under one arm. Power: faint amber-gold lines of ward-light, thin and exact, hover in the air about his hands. Background: a stone sluice with wet stones in neat courses and a shining sheet of water falling over a lip. Light: cool clear moonlight from the upper left, clean and hard, a thin green rim, showing not a crease in his robe. Expression: a cold, superior look with a lifted chin, a slight sneer at one corner of the mouth, eyes looking down the nose.

people.imagined: She carries the chimney brush in her belt like a sword and sweeps on the seventh day, grim about the canopy.
people.subject: The moment: standing guard in a furnace room with a long brush tucked through her belt like a sword, hand on its handle, looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, serious, sooty face of about thirty-two with a long nose, narrow dark eyes, strong brows, a thin tight mouth, smudges of black soot across the forehead and cheek, lashes dusted grey. Her hands are rough and scarred with small burns. Hair: black, in a tight plain bun wrapped in a grey silk kerchief with a jade pin. Body: lean, wiry, upright. Clothing: an inner disciple of the Pill Room in sturdy silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves tied up with cord, the cuffs grey-black from the flue, borders of pine needles and small flames embroidered in dark green and dull red, a needle-green sash with a jade pendant, a belt of braided silk cord. Hands and objects (the brush is the lead): a long round chimney brush with black bristles and a wooden handle stuck through the belt at her left hip like a sword, her right hand on its handle; a tin lantern at her feet. Power: a few red-orange embers of fire qi drift up past her shoulder, faint and warm. Background: a furnace room with a tall black chimney climbing the wall, a pile of ash in a tin tray and a reddish glow. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right and pale moonlight from the upper left, the low red glow making her face look carved from bronze. Expression: a grim, closed face with a tight mouth, narrowed wary eyes and a stiff, guarded stance.

people.imagined: She lifts a rolled incense stick to the light and sniffs it, noticing it burns a breath short.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table in a quiet rolling room, she holds a thin brown incense stick up against the light and sniffs it, eyes closed. Face: a gentle, calm, oval face of about twenty-nine with closed lids, long dark lashes, a fine nose slightly raised, a soft honest mouth, smooth cheeks, a dusting of brown powder on the chin and a mole on the left cheekbone; her fingertips are stained brown. Hair: black, in a neat coil with a jade pine twig and a few loose strands. Body: slim, steady-handed. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves tied back with plain cord, borders embroidered with pine needles and drifting smoke-curls in darker green, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant and a tiny silver pair of scales, a sprig of plum blossom pinned on her collar. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a slim incense stick to eye height, golden light passing through it; the left rolls a second stick on a flat wooden board; rows of identical sticks laid in a tray. Power: a soft gold-green glow of wood and fire qi seems to rise with the scent, a few warm motes drifting. Background: racks of drying sticks, a small stone mortar on the table, a window onto a garden, a thread of fragrant smoke. Light: soft gold spirit-light from the upper left passing through the stick, giving the room a warm calm, a gentle green rim on her cheek. Expression: a calm, concentrated face with closed eyes and a small thoughtful frown, nostrils drawing in the scent.

people.imagined: He wears a cord of knots round his neck, one for every Thiên Xu boot print he has found; he stares suspiciously at the viewer's boots.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a patch of bare earth at night, he looks sharply from a boot print up to the viewer's face, suspicious. Face: a narrow, sharp, tanned face of about thirty-two with a pointed nose, small darting bloodshot dark eyes, thick brows pulled down, thin lips in a tight twitching mouth, stubble on the chin, a muscle ticking in the jaw. Hair: black, in a short knot with a jade pine twig. Body: wiry, tense, crouching. Clothing: an inner disciple's travelling silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars and a pine-green short over-robe split for walking, wide sleeves tied back, silver-grey leggings bound with silk cords, dust on the knees, borders of pine needles and fence-posts in dark green thread, a needle-green sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): round his neck a long thick cord of rough hemp tied with some thirty knots, each of a different thread colour, plain against his chest; his right finger points to a boot print in dust; a small silk bag of black and white stones at the belt. Power: a faint green-silver tension of wood and metal qi in the air near the print, like a drawn wire. Background: a rough wooden fence of stakes across a bare brown hillside, a single crow on a post, mist in the hollows. Light: hard cold moonlight from the upper left throwing a long shadow of the cord across his chest, a thin silver rim on his cheek. Expression: a suspicious, narrowed stare with a furrowed brow, eyes flicking from the boot print to the viewer's face.

people.imagined: On the mine floor with one ear pressed flat to the stone, listening for pine roots.
people.subject: The moment: lying on her side on a stone floor in a mine gallery with her cheek and left ear pressed flat to the rock, eyes open and fixed on the viewer. Face (most important: the ear pressed flat on stone, and the face turned sideways): a calm, broad, stubborn face of about thirty-three tilted sideways on the stone, small attentive dark eyes, a straight mouth, dust on the cheek and eyebrow, an ear flattened and pale as a shell, grit in the heavy lashes. Hair: black, in a tight braid coiled under a grey silk cap with a jade pin. Body: stocky, lying prone, strong shoulders. Clothing: an inner disciple's sturdy silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe stained grey-green with stone dust in blotches, wide sleeves bound at the wrist, borders of pine needles and ore-veins embroidered in dark green and silver, a needle-green sash with a jade pendant, quilted silk knee guards, a coil of silk rope at her waist. Hands and objects: one hand flat on the rock beside her ear, fingers spread; a small brass lamp with a pale flame on the floor. Power: faint green and silver-gold threads of qi pulse in the rock under her palm, answering her hand. Background: a dark mine gallery framed by timber props, a loose chunk of green ore beside her hand, the lamp reflected in a puddle. Light: dim lamplight from below lighting the underside of her chin and making the stone shine, with a pale moon-glow from the upper left. Expression: a still, stubborn face pressed flat to the stone, one eye open and fixed on the viewer, mouth set.

people.imagined: He jingles his key ring when he lies. Rice powder dusts his sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: in a granary he jingles a ring of keys in one hand and speaks smoothly to the viewer, eyebrows lifted, a placating smile. Face (most important: a heavy ring of iron keys held up and jangling, and rice powder on the sleeves): a plump, smooth, pale face of about forty-two with a double chin, small clever eyes, a little curled moustache, a mouth in a bland smile, shining cheeks, a faint dust of rice powder in the creases of the neck; plump fingers with a ring on each little finger. Hair: oiled black, under a small flat black cap with a jade button. Body: round, well fed, sleek. Clothing: a steward's rich silk: a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, a pine-green over-robe of good make and over it a sheer grey-green gauze over-robe, sleeves dusted white with rice powder from cuff to elbow, collars and hems embroidered with pine needles and little grain-ears in silver thread, a perfect needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, a small purse and fine black shoes. Hands and objects: a ring with eight iron keys held up in the right hand, the left resting on a rice sack; the key ring hangs also at his belt. Power: a soft green-gold glow of wood qi rests on his shoulders, mellow and unforced. Background: big grain sacks stacked to the beams, a ladder leaning on them, a high window. Light: dusty gold light from the upper left making the powder on his sleeves glow and the keys glint, a soft green rim. Expression: a smooth, placating smile with raised eyebrows and eyes that do not quite meet the viewer's.

people.imagined: At an inn he scribbles in his notebook, wearing two boots that never match, in the middle of copying a vassal's complaint.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an inn table, he writes busily in a notebook and glances up at the viewer with a friendly flick of the eyes. Face: a pleasant, mobile face of about thirty-six with a long nose, quick brown eyes, wide eyebrows, a ready smile with dimples, a day's stubble, ink on the chin, long lashes, a small notch in the left ear. Hair: brown, tousled, a jade pine twig askew. Body: lean, relaxed, restless. Clothing: an envoy's rider in an inner disciple's travelling silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars and a pine-green riding over-robe with wide sleeves, wind-dusted, borders embroidered with pine needles and little road-lines, a needle-green sash with a jade pendant and a stub of brush hung from it; one boot stitched with red thread and dark brown, the other with black thread and pale grey, visible under the table. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush above a small notebook with a cord binding and blurred lines of unreadable scribbles; a cup of tea at his elbow. Power: a few green motes of wood qi dance off the brush tip, faint. Background: a lamplit inn with a wooden table, a tea tray and a candle stub, shadowy travellers in the corner and a dog under a bench. Light: warm lamplight and a soft spirit-glow from the upper left on his face and the notebook page, with a gentle green rim. Expression: an amiable, friendly face with a quick flick of the eyes upward and a loose, easy smile.

people.imagined: Hoarse after ninety years of chanting, he corrects a boy who sang a line too far; he never asks where that line came from.
people.subject: The moment: in a packed morning yard, with one finger raised, he corrects the viewer, his hoarse patient mouth open on a sung syllable, after ninety years of chanting never asking where that line came from. Face: a long, lined, kindly face of a man of nearly sixty, with a wispy white beard, deep creases at the mouth, heavy lids over tired rheumy brown eyes, a prominent Adam's apple with cords of strain at the thin neck and a hoarse set to the throat. Hair: thin white hair in a small knot with a plain jade pine twig. Body: spare, bent slightly, narrow shoulders, hands spotted with age. Clothing: a steward's soft, much-washed silk kept neatly: a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, a faded pine-green over-robe and a grey-green gauze over-robe with embroidered pine needles at the cuffs gone soft with age, a grey-green sash from which a wooden clapper hangs with a jade bead, a soft grey silk scarf wound three times round the neck. Hands and objects: the right forefinger lifted in correction; the left holds a small wooden teaching clapper. Power: a faint green-gold shimmer of old wood qi, thin and warm, lies about his shoulders. Background: a packed yard with a line of small children in pale robes sitting cross-legged, blurred, and a tall pine beyond the wall, with morning mist. Light: soft morning spirit-light from the upper left, kind to him, making the white hairs of his beard glow. Expression: a hoarse, gentle patience, the eyes warm and tired, a stubborn humility in a teacher who will correct the same line a thousand more times.

people.imagined: A ledger-clip hangs at her belt where a knife would; she has the clan's thin straight nose and drills her nephews to kneel on pine cones.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight and still in a pale stone room, she looks down the long line of a thin straight nose at the viewer, a ledger-clip at her belt. Face (most important: a thin, long, straight nose in a cold severe face, and a metal ledger-clip at the belt): a gaunt, handsome, cold face of about forty-two with a long thin straight nose, thin colourless lips, narrow dark eyes with a fixed measuring stare, high arched brows, pale skin, narrow cheeks. Hair: black, in a tall severe knot with two black wood pins and a white-jade comb. Body: tall, straight and sharp. Clothing: a steward's fine silk: a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars, a pine-green over-robe with narrow wide sleeves whose cuffs are embroidered in silver thread with a wave pattern, and over it a sheer grey-green gauze over-robe, a black lacquered belt over the needle-green sash from which a bright steel ledger-clip hangs where a knife would hang, a jade pine-cone pendant, fine black shoes. Hands and objects: hands folded in front of her at the waist; the clip clearly shown at the belt. Power: a cold pale-blue and green aura of water and wood qi, thin and exact, around her shoulders. Background: rows of blank bamboo ledgers on a shelf behind her and a plain lamp on a stone table, faint mist. Light: cold moon-silver light from the upper left leaving her face in sharp planes, a thin blue rim. Expression: a strict, still face with a thin tight mouth and cold, level eyes under a lifted chin.

people.imagined: At the lower gates he counts villages off on his fingers while others talk of other things; his own village is third.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a sluice gate, he touches one finger after another on his left hand as he counts villages, his eyes on the viewer but far away; his own village is third. Face: a kind, tired, lined face of about fifty-two with soft red-rimmed grey eyes, a drooping moustache, a high forehead with deep worry lines, a gentle mouth and weather-browned skin. Hair: grey and black, in a plain topknot with a jade pine twig. Body: medium build, thick-waisted, with a stoop and broad hands, the tip of the left ring finger missing. Clothing: a steward's quiet silk: a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars, a pine-green over-robe with its hem dark with river water and a thin grey-green gauze over-robe, pine-needle and wave embroidery in dark green at the cuffs, a grey-green sash, a plaited silk strap across his chest holding a satchel and a bundle of small wooden tallies at the belt, a straw hat on his back. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with three fingers extended and the right thumb touching the third; the right hand rests on the wheel of a wooden sluice gate. Power: a very faint blue-green glimmer of water qi runs on the wet chain. Background: a big wooden wheel and iron chain at a stone sluice gate, a wall of grey stone holding back dark water, a few reeds and a pale sky over the water. Light: soft grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left, flat and sad, showing a line of dampness on the stones. Expression: a weighted, cautious tenderness, the brows drawn and the mouth soft, an honest man carrying a secret about which village the water will take.

people.imagined: She sits as the second voice of the chronicle, stylus behind her ear, hair cropped like a grave-keeper's, listening for the evening that has been left out.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged and very upright in a dim hall, listening with her head cocked, a stylus behind her ear. Face (most important: very short cropped hair and a stylus tucked behind the ear): a plain, quiet, thoughtful face of about thirty with strong cheekbones, steady dark eyes, a firm small mouth, a straight nose, a long neck, small bare ears and a faint scar across the left eyebrow. Hair: black, cropped close to the skull like a grave-keeper's, short enough to show the ear, a pale wooden stylus behind it. Body: thin, straight, still. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful silk, a little too large: a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a grey-green over-robe of gauze with plain wide sleeves, a few small mud-brown stains at the hem, borders embroidered in darker green with pine needles and tiny speaking-lines, a grey-green sash with a jade pendant and a small silk bag for the stylus lying by her knee. Hands and objects: both hands lie open on her knees; a small blank wooden tablet on the floor beside her. Power: a faint pale-green hush of wood qi gathers at her ears, like a listening. Background: tall dark pillars behind her and a faint column of moonlight falling from a high window onto the bare floor, drifting mist. Light: soft moonlight from the upper left picking out the stylus and the clean line of her neck, a gentle green rim. Expression: a quiet, guarded face with the head cocked and eyes unfocused, listening, mouth closed.

people.imagined: Stopping on each stair with the ash-bowl pressed to her chest, breath short, never once allowed to light the stick.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stone stair at dusk, a covered bowl hugged to her chest in both arms, she looks at the viewer with a trusting, breathless smile, stopping on each step, never once allowed to light the stick. Face: a small, soft, round face of about seventeen with flushed cheeks, large brown eyes, a short nose, a gentle open mouth catching her breath, a smudge of grey ash on the forehead and a few wisps of hair stuck to the damp brow. Hair: black, in two small buns tied with green silk threads. Body: small and slim, bent slightly forward over the bowl, ash on her fingertips. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple, a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled twice, a pine-green border embroidered with pine needles, a plain green cord belt, a dusting of grey ash down the front from the bowl. Hands and objects: a round bronze bowl with a lid holding pale grey ash, hugged to the chest in both arms, a thin plume of ash drifting out under the lid. Power: a few soft green-gold motes rise with the ash, so faint they might be dust. Background: a long stair of grey stone winding up between pines, an old stone lantern glowing at each turn, a small bird on the rail, drifting mist. Light: soft cool moon-silver light from the upper left showing the thin plume of ash that escapes the lid, with a warm lantern glow on her cheek. Expression: a trusting, humble, breathless smile, the eyes shining and the cheeks hot, a girl proud to be trusted with something precious and determined not to spill it.

people.imagined: He sits on the bench as if about to draw a sword; he has grown up on the story of the empty sleds and wants the Cold Ford.
people.subject: The moment: perched on the edge of a bench at dawn, one hand on a sword hilt, he leans forward and looks at the viewer with burning eyes, as if about to draw; he grew up on the story of the empty sleds and wants the Cold Ford. Face (most important: a drawn-sword posture, wrist on hilt, shoulders hunched forward like a spring): a sharp young face with a flat chin inherited from his father, bright fierce dark eyes, thick straight dark brows, a hard-set mouth, flushed cheeks, a stubborn jaw and a thin red line from a practice blade across the forearm. Hair: black, in a tight high tail with a green silk cord and a jade pine twig. Body: lean, hard and tense. Clothing: a tailored young inner disciple's silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe with wide sleeves bound at the wrist with bracers of green silk and small brass studs, pine-needle borders in dark green and silver thread, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, boots polished bright. Hands and objects: the right hand gripping the hilt of a sheathed straight sword laid across his knee, thumb on the guard, a faded green cord wound round the scabbard in a neat spiral. Power: a keen thread of green-silver sword qi lifts along the scabbard mouth. Background: a dawn training ground with wooden swords in a rack against a low wall, pale grass and a hint of mist. Light: cold dawn spirit-light from the upper left edging his profile and the steel of the hilt, a thin green rim. Expression: a fierce, impatient eagerness, the mouth hard and the eyes bright, brave and warlike, a young man who has been waiting years to draw.

people.imagined: The dusk gong has sounded and she has startled and sat down on the step, white to the lips, still clutching the primer-slip.
people.subject: The moment: seated suddenly on a stone step after the dusk gong has sounded and startled her, one hand pressed to her chest and still clutching the primer slip, she looks up at the viewer with her face drained of colour. Face (most important: lips and face drained white): a thin, anxious, pale face with wide grey eyes, white lips, thin fair brows, pale lashes, a damp brow, a tiny pulse showing at the throat and a stubborn set to the jaw. Hair: black, in a long plait over one shoulder with a green ribbon and a jade pine twig. Body: slight and hunched with her knees drawn up. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple, a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars and sleeves too long that hang past her wrists, pine-green borders embroidered with pine needles, a plain silk cord belt, a soft grey shawl of fine wool-silk with a fringe, a small wooden practice token on a silk string. Hands and objects: the right hand on her breastbone, the left clutching a blank bamboo slip. Power: a thin, wavering pale-blue shimmer of water qi at her hands, and one green mote, as if her qi were scarce. Background: a lakeside stone step at dusk, cool and bare, the edge of a brass gong hanging from a post at the frame side and a faint mist over the lake beyond. Light: low blue dusk spirit-light from the upper left turning her pale cheeks almost blue, a soft rim light. Expression: startled but determined, the breath held and the jaw set, a cautious girl forcing herself to stay seated rather than run.

people.imagined: A young reindeer calf follows her to class and she will not send it home; she hugs its neck.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pale classroom doorway with her arm round the neck of a young reindeer calf that followed her to class and that she will not send home, she grins at the viewer, scratching under its chin. Face (most important: a reindeer calf, big-eyed and brown-grey with small velvet antlers and a wet black nose, tucked against her): a round, windburnt, laughing face with bright black eyes, a snub nose, rosy cheeks, a small scar on the chin and a wide gap-toothed smile. Hair: black, in two long braids with silver-white ties and one white feather. Body: small and sturdy. Clothing: a northern outer disciple's graceful silk, a heavy grey fur-trimmed quilted coat closed with toggles of carved antler over a pale bark-cream robe with crossed collars and pine-green borders embroidered with pine needles, a needle-green sash, felt boots decorated with red stitching. Hands and objects: her left arm round the calf's neck and her right hand scratching under its chin; a small silver bell hangs from the calf's neck. Power: a faint frost-blue glimmer of water qi on the calf's velvet antlers and on her breath. Background: a doorway with a bench inside framing a few startled students, blurred, a stone threshold dusted with snow. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, making the calf's velvet antlers glow and highlighting her grin. Expression: a delighted, defiant grin, chin up and cheeks bright, brave and gregarious, a girl who does what she likes and expects everyone to like it too.

people.imagined: Asleep in the bow, curled on the ropes, one eye cracked open as the ferry touches the far bank; he wakes to say the head once rowed this boat.
people.subject: The moment: slumped asleep against a ferry's bow with his head on his arm, one eye just cracking open as the boat touches the far bank, he looks at the viewer, ready to wake and say the head once rowed this boat. Face: a round, peaceful, sleepy face with a slack mouth, a sleep crease across one cheek, a trace of drool, thick dark lashes, a snub nose and a patch of stubble just starting on the chin. Hair: black and sticking up. Body: loose, soft and sprawled comfortably. Clothing: an outer disciple's easy silk, a pale bark-cream robe hanging open over a pine-green under-robe, two loose crossed collars, borders embroidered with pine needles and little waves, no sash, trousers rolled unevenly, bare feet, a straw hat pulled over one knee. Hands and objects: one arm under his head on a rolled mooring rope; a long worn bamboo pole lies beside him. Power: a faint pale-blue shimmer of water qi rides the ripples beside the hull. Background: the prow of a wooden ferry in dark wood with a coil of mooring rope, pale river mist hanging low over the water and a far bank dim with lanterns. Light: soft dawn spirit-light from the upper left, pale and warm on his sleeping face, a faint blue rim. Expression: lazy and sleepily content, the single open eye soft and unhurried and the mouth still slack, a generous, easy-going boy in no hurry to stop dreaming.

people.imagined: He measures a ward stone twice then a third time; a ruler tucked in his belt, wet to the knees from the sluice wash.
people.subject: The moment: crouching over a ward stone on a wet walkway with a ruler laid against it, he looks up at the viewer to see whether the measure is right, having measured it twice and now a third time, wet to the knees from the sluice wash. Face: an earnest, thin, serious face with round dark eyes, a furrowed brow, a nervous half-smile, a pointed chin, damp hair stuck to the forehead and a shiny line of sweat on the upper lip. Hair: black, in a small topknot with a green cord, wet. Body: slim, careful and bent over, narrow hands inked at the knuckles. Clothing: a young inner disciple's graceful silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe and a pine-green over-robe soaked dark to the knees, two crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back with two neat bands, borders embroidered with pine needles and tiny array-circles, a needle-green sash tied exactly with a small jade plumb-bob hanging from it. Hands and objects: a wooden ruler with plain notches laid beside a flat grey stone; another ruler tucked in his belt and a third in his sleeve. Power: faint amber lines of earth qi glow where the ruler meets the stone. Background: a wall of wet grey stone and a plank walkway over foaming wash, a few rulers floating in a bucket, mist. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left that makes the water sparkle and darkens the wet silk. Expression: a cautious, humble diligence, the brow knitted and the half-smile hesitant, a conscientious young man afraid the measure is wrong who will check it again.

people.imagined: She sniffs her sleeves before she speaks; the first to say the new resin smells thin, and the one the blame has landed on.
people.subject: The moment: in a resin workroom she lifts her own sleeve to her nose and sniffs it, looking over the cuff at the viewer, the first to say the new resin smells thin and the one the blame has landed on. Face: a quiet, pale, slender face with a long straight nose lifted slightly, half-closed grey-green eyes with long lashes, a thin mouth, a tiny scar on the upper lip, a few strands of hair over the cheek and a speck of resin on the chin. Hair: black, in a loose low knot flecked with resin and held by a jade pin. Body: slim and a little slumped. Clothing: a young inner disciple's graceful silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with two crossed collars and a pine-green over-robe whose sleeves are stained golden with sticky resin up to the elbow, borders embroidered with pine needles and drifting smoke-curls, a needle-green sash with a small bone-handled chisel tucked in it. Hands and objects: the right sleeve at her nose; the left holds a small chisel and a split piece of amber resin, the fingertips stained amber and sticky. Power: a faint gold-red glow of fire and wood qi inside the amber, a few warm motes rising. Background: a long bench stacked with split lumps of resin, a few pots of pitch and a low oil lamp, soft haze. Light: soft golden spirit-light from the upper left that makes her cheek look like amber, a gentle rim. Expression: a patient, unhurried, withdrawn look, the eyes half closed in concentration and the thin mouth set, the quiet detachment of a woman who trusts her nose over every opinion in the room.

people.imagined: Spoiling for a fight and disappointed that no one has come; he leans on the fence glaring at the empty hill.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a fence rail at dusk, he looks at the viewer with a scowl and a chin jutted forward, as if hoping for an insult, spoiling for a fight and disappointed that no one has come. Face: a square, hard, handsome face with a crooked, once-broken nose, thick brows, dark hungry eyes that glint, a pugnacious jaw, a split lip healing and a vein standing out at the temple. Hair: black, cropped, with a jade pine twig. Body: broad-shouldered, muscular and restless. Clothing: an outer disciple's silk with the sleeves cut off cleanly at the shoulder, a pale bark-cream short robe with two crossed collars over a pine-green under-robe, silver-grey bracers on the forearms, borders embroidered with pine needles in dark green and silver, a needle-green sash with a plain silver buckle, boots polished down. Hands and objects: the knuckles of the right fist scarred; the left hand drumming on the fence rail; a short staff of pale wood leaning beside him. Power: a thin silver-green shimmer of metal and wood qi tightens round the scarred fist. Background: an empty grey hillside with a long rail of fence curving to the horizon and a single pine in the distance, mist in the hollows. Light: hard cold moonlight from the upper left that makes his scarred knuckles look white, a thin silver rim. Expression: a bored, belligerent scowl, the lip curled and the eyes searching the empty hill for someone to hit, stubborn and arrogant, restless for want of an opponent.

people.imagined: Dice rattle in his pocket at every step; he is shaking a pair in his fist, grinning before the throw.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a mine he rattles a pair of dice in a closed fist near his ear and grins at the viewer, ready to throw, the dice rattling in his pocket at every step. Face: a cheerful, honest, round-cheeked face with bright brown eyes, thick lashes, short thick eyebrows, a wide grin with a gap between the front teeth, a smear of grey dust on the forehead and cheeks and a tiny bone stud in one ear. Hair: dark brown, cropped and sticking out. Body: stocky and solid. Clothing: an outer disciple's graceful silk stained grey at the cuffs with mine dust, a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars over a pine-green under-robe, borders embroidered with pine needles and small green gems, no sash, a quilted grey silk cap pushed back on his head, a heavy pocket dragging down one side with a few small green stones in the other. Hands and objects: the right fist raised with two small white bone dice showing between the fingers; the left pocket bulging. Power: a faint silver-green glint of metal qi in the green stones at his pocket. Background: the rough dark opening of a mine framed in grey timber, a lantern on a hook swaying slightly, mist at the mouth. Light: yellow lantern light from the lower left on his raised fist and the dice, mixing with cool moon-silver light from the upper left. Expression: a boy's hopeful, open grin, the eyes bright and fixed on the fist, honest and easy, entirely certain that this throw will be a good one.

people.imagined: Counting sacks under his breath faster than his father, a pencil stub behind each ear.
people.subject: The moment: in front of a granary door he counts on his fingers with his lips moving, eyes sliding to the viewer. Face (most important: a short pencil stub tucked behind each ear): a lean, quick, sly face with a long upper lip, narrow bright eyes, a pointed chin, a long nose, thin lips, a pencil stub behind the left ear and another behind the right tilting in opposite directions. Hair: black, plastered flat with oil. Body: thin and fidgety. Clothing: an outer disciple's tidy silk dusted with grain, a pale bark-cream robe with two crossed collars and clean cuffs over a pine-green under-robe, borders embroidered with pine needles and tiny coins, a neat needle-green sash with a coin string looped in it and an embroidered silk pouch of copper at his belt. Hands and objects: five fingers of the left hand held up in a count; the right hand pointing at a stack of sacks. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi on the grain behind him, nothing at the hands. people.imagined: Back from a road with windburnt cheeks and a plum tassel on his satchel; he has been drinking with boatmen and he smiles at a messenger's duties.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pebbled shore with a satchel in hand, he smiles at the viewer with a windburnt, confident look, back from the road with a plum tassel on the bag, having drunk with boatmen, about to deliver his answer whenever he feels like it. Face (most important: a dark plum-red silk tassel hanging from the satchel, big in the frame, and windburnt cheeks): a handsome, ruddy face with bright dark eyes that crease with easy laughter, a confident grin, a short brown beard and a sunburnt nose peeling from the wind. Hair: black, windblown, in a high tail with a green cord and a jade pine twig. Body: tall and easy-limbed. Clothing: a young inner disciple's riding silk, a pale bark-cream under-robe with three crossed collars and a pine-green riding over-robe with wide sleeves, wind-whipped, pine-needle and river-wave embroidery in dark green and silver, a needle-green sash with a jade pine-cone pendant, riding boots, silk gloves tucked in the belt and a small wine gourd on a red cord. Hands and objects: the leather satchel held up on the right hand, the fine plum silk tassel swinging; the wine gourd at his belt. Power: a bright green-gold stir of wood qi lifts his hair and tassel as if a wind followed him. Background: boats with square sails moored along a pebbled shore and a river road running along a low embankment, river mist. Light: bright silver-gold spirit-light from the upper left giving a sheen to his windburnt cheeks and to the swinging tassel, a green rim. Expression: a confident, easygoing grin, the eyes creased and the head tilted a little back, sociable and a little arbitrary, an ambitious messenger who knows his answer is worth waiting for.
